rationale: All four lenses and the standards audit ran with parseable output; every story AC and spec decision passes, with D11's real-machine check pending Stage 7. All 17 lens candidates were dismissed after reading the source: they are already handled (readVsCodeClaudeCodeGateway never throws, the corrupt connector file is refused on write), are behaviour the spec sanctions (D5 lookup rules, AC9/AC10 status and JSON output), or are reachable only through hand-edited state. Nothing was deferred.

standards_review.notes: 1 subject in range, feat(proxy): add --claude-otlp and --copilot-otlp, one analytics flag per vendor, uses allowed type feat and allowed scope proxy, imperative, under the 100-char subject-max-length

new src/cli/commands/proxy/analytics-clients.ts is 494 lines (under the 500-line file guideline), kebab-case, .js/node: imports, explicit return types and JSDoc on every export; connect-orchestrator.ts stays over 500 lines but was already larger at base and this change shrinks it (+69/-110); console.log calls are user-facing CLI output in the existing chalk pattern, not debug output; processes.ts getCommandPath adds a documented options param with explicit Promise<string | null> return

added non-test source lines touch no X-CodeMie attribution header, Responses user field or JWT override, log no credentials, and add no file reads/writes from user-supplied paths; getCommandPath keeps exec with an argv array (no shell) and the $PATH: where.exe guard
